review_method.disposition_rule: Every candidate is independently checked against the original page image. Literal child-count, sex/order, obstetric, illness/disability, adoption/heir and concrete family-event claims remain CASE_SUPPORT_ONLY. Preserve source-explicit DECADE_YEAR as a dual layer; generic response hubs without a stated time layer remain HOLD. P04 later-generation projections are limited to personally cultivated juniors/protégés; ordinary staff, subordinates and general networks remain P08. Do not infer 行至 from a hub list.

source_anchors.description: Chen-Xu Ziwei-Tianxiang adverse-condition continuation after CH01's positive clause; the source names 武曲天府 and 廉贞 as response hubs but gives no YEAR/DECADE trigger.

Si-Hai Ziwei-Qisha: literal child-count and affliction claims, strong disposition/generation-gap, child distance, moralized greed outcome, junior exploitation, entrepreneurial ability, junior burden, distant entrepreneurship and broad protégé network.

General Ziwei-in-P04 section: late children versus late disciples/followers, preference for lateness, Fubi requirement for direct help, other auxiliaries benefiting juniors, and traditional adoption/secondary-household/stepwife child claims.
Tianji general and Ziwu Tianji/Jumen: traditional child-count branches separated from junior scarcity, turnover, unstable relations and disciple closeness.

Ziwu Tianji: obstetric/early-separation case claims; favorable professional-development direction; Hua-Ji personality advice; and an untyped response-hub candidate held because the legacy YEAR label is unsupported.
Opening Chou-Wei Tianji-Tianliang paragraph: traditional child-count/obstetric claims and the explicit extension to very few, frequently changing juniors.
Chou-Wei Tianji-Tianliang continuation: junior scarcity and turnover, child status and count branches, personality/development advice, and the source-explicit 流年大运 response hubs.

Yin-Shen Tianji-Taiyin: traditional child count/sex, secondary-household and heir claims, obstetric/illness claims, child quality/temperament descriptions, and a generic response hub without a stated time layer.
Mao-You Tianji-Jumen: traditional child-count claims, intergenerational discord and junior relations, Hua-Ji distinctions, surface harmony versus inner reservation, and an untyped response hub.

Chen-Xu Tianji-Tianliang: obstetric/illness/distance cases, child development and ability, later-generation relation extension, Fire/Bell and Yang/Tuo advice, borrowed Solar-Jumen speech development, and generic response hubs.
